title: Resolution to set 6% late-tax interest rate for small properties
summary: This resolution sets the interest rate for late property tax payments at 6 percent per year for Fiscal Year 2027, for properties assessed at no more than $250,000, or co-op units valued at no more than $250,000 each. This keeps the rate unchanged from Fiscal Year 2025 and 2026, rather than adopting the Banking Commission's recommended 8 percent rate. The Council cites declining delinquency rates as evidence the current rate is effective.
